description: The no-filing route as the registry directs it to be led with. Veteran, misdemeanour deferred adjudication completed, court-approved veterans reemployment programme completed after the offence, no family violence, court has not asked for a petition. Nothing is filed and no fee arises. The hearing, the best-interest finding, the order and DPS's acts all stay blank.
syntheticDataNote: All values are obviously synthetic and are never drawn from any evidence file. Names are SAMPLE/EXAMPLE strings, the court is an EXAMPLE court, and every date is a round synthetic value. Dates here are participant screening answers, not sourced facts.

caseData.sentencingCourt: EXAMPLE County Court at Law No. 0, EXAMPLE County, Texas
caseData.sentencingCourtNote: The participant's own screening answer. Venue is the SENTENCING court, not the county of arrest.
caseData.causeNumberNote: The participant's own screening answer, read off the discharge and dismissal order or the judgment. Blank here; never prefilled.
caseData.countyOfArrest: [NOT RELEVANT TO VENUE ON THIS TRACK]

screeningAnswers.sentencingCourt: EXAMPLE County Court at Law No. 0, EXAMPLE County, Texas
screeningAnswers.priorOrSubsequentOffences: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN LIST — CONFIRMED AGAINST THE DPS CRIMINAL HISTORY]
screeningAnswers.feeWaiverRequested: not applicable — nothing is filed on this route
screeningAnswers.reemploymentProgramme: yes — court-approved veterans reemployment programme completed after the offence
screeningAnswers.courtRequiresPetition: no — not yet asked / court has not said it requires one

confirmAgainstDocuments.obtainedFrom: Texas Department of Public Safety Crime Records Service
confirmAgainstDocuments.howToObtain: DPS form CR-63, an instruction sheet rather than a form to complete.

confirmAgainstDocuments.document: The discharge and dismissal order, or the judgment and order of community supervision
confirmAgainstDocuments.obtainedFrom: The clerk of the court that sentenced the person or placed the person on community supervision
confirmAgainstDocuments.howToObtain: Ask the clerk for the order.

confirmAgainstDocuments.document: Record of successful completion of the veterans reemployment programme
confirmAgainstDocuments.obtainedFrom: The court-approved programme, or the court that approved it
confirmAgainstDocuments.howToObtain: Ask the programme or the court for confirmation of successful completion.

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisNote: No eligibility conclusion is asserted. The court decides whether issuance is in the best interest of justice.
eligibilityData.waitingPeriodNote: None. The trigger is successful completion of the programme and of all community-supervision conditions.
eligibilityData.feeNote: No fee arises on the no-filing route. Nothing is filed.

protectedFieldsNote: Blank and never prefilled. No document is drafted on this unit, and the OCA forms the petition route uses are not drafted or filled by this lane at all.
outsidePartyFieldsNote: The hearing, the best-interest-of-justice finding, the judge's signature, the state's decision whether to request a hearing within 45 days, the prosecutor's position, entry of the order, and DPS's sealing and notification acts are all court, state or agency acts. Every one is blank and none is asserted, predicted or implied.
